name: smartware-kit
description: Smartware 2.0: the memory and context protocol kit. Engine, server, clients, adapters, doctor and eval.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/server packages/client packages/adapters packages/connectors
scripts.test:py: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . && python3 tools/bridge/run_suite.py -q && cd clients/python && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
scripts.fuzz: node tools/fuzz/persist_fuzz.mjs 20 150 && python3 tools/fuzz/diff_fuzz.py 25 120 1 --frozen-clock --idprob=1 && python3 tools/fuzz/diff_fuzz.py 12 120 100 --frozen-clock --idprob=1 --reopen
